scope: Asyncio/HTTPX2 durable request reservation, cancellation and SIGKILL engineering checks plus isolated PydanticAI integration; explicit fake loopback services, no neural/GPU/cloud calls.
core_environment: existing model-request-budget-20261121, no installs/changes; expected HTTPX2=2.16.2
core_focused: unittest -v test_async_request_budget, expected8checks including real SIGKILL
full_suite: unittest discover -s tests -v after focused8pass; no manufactured missing-API baseline defect
limitations: New opt-in async client; existing maintenance-worker async rejection and sync transport stay unchanged.
Request attempts and JSON bytes are not tokens, cost, accepted replies or exactly-once tool effects.
Cancellation can consume a reservation without sending; in-flight unknowns remain charged; no refund/reset.
Cancellation during durable I/O waits for it to finish; no claim of a hard cancellation-latency bound under a held OS lock.
Asyncio only, not a Trio compatibility claim; loopback chat-completions POST only, no Responses/cloud/redirect/proxy support.
PydanticAI uses an isolated new budget-only distribution; no upstream defect/PR or model-autonomy claim.
Repeated focused tests overlap the full suite; framework cases are reported separately, not added as new core tests.
